versions.changelog: v1.0.2: Security audit fix - transform entire skill from operational/persuasive to pure diagnostic framework. All modules now output analysis and testable hypotheses only, never recommendations or tactics.
Security audit fixes: narrowed trigger description (High: Vague Triggers), added Ethical Use Policy with prohibited use cases and mandatory disclosure notice (Medium x3: Missing User Warnings)
Initial release: 7-module human behavior analysis system (Needs, Attention, Trust, Decision, Emotion, Spread, Prediction)
